parts.when: [Either player's Fight phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase), after an enemy unit picks its targets.
parts.target: A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA TZEENTCH** unit of yours that the enemy unit picked as a target.
parts.effect:
Roll a D6; you can then spend a [Flux token](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.scintillating-legion.fates-in-flux) for a re-roll of it. Whenever an attack targets the unit and its unmodified [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls), with any re-roll applied, matches that number, its attack sequence stops there, for the rest of the phase. This applies even to an attack whose first Hit roll was a **Critical Hit**.

**Example**: you roll a 2, spend a Flux token on a re-roll, and get a 6. Then every attack against the unit for the rest of the phase whose unmodified Hit roll is 6 stops its attack sequence there: it misses, and Critical Hit effects, such as [Lethal Hits](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits), do not resolve.
